description: This file defines the 'ReasonerDetailPage' React component responsible for displaying detailed information about a specific reasoner, including its input/output schemas, execution controls, history, and performance metrics.

methods.name: handleExecute
methods.description: Handles initiating the execution process after validating the input form, adding the execution to the queue, and updating the UI state.

methods.name: handleExecutionComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked after an execution completes, used to refresh history and metrics, and auto-select the completed execution for display.

methods.name: handleExecutionSelect
methods.description: Handles user selection of a specific execution from the queue for detailed viewing.

methods.name: handleCopyCommand
methods.description: Copies a preformatted cURL command for API testing to clipboard.

methods.name: toggleResultView
methods.description: Switches between formatted and JSON views for execution results.
